**Welcome!**

I'm an assistant professor at [LEDa, Université Paris-Dauphine](https://leda.dauphine.fr/) in Paris, France. I work on **economics relevant to climate change**. In particular, I am interested in estimating climate change impacts, assessing adaptation options and designing optimal mitigation policies, mostly by using applied modeling tools.
